title: Maintenance
description: Service performed on a device already in active use - preventive maintenance, calibration, a corrective repair, a software update. Distinct from measurement: this is a claim by whoever performed the service, not a sensor reading (spec Sec.6). A capital device overdue on this history is itself something a client can flag, independent of any single measurement.

reference.description: Reference to the service record, held off-chain.
